title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.2
body_markdown:
## Case management


- fix(cases): Hide Mermaid source alongside rendered diagrams ([#3542](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3542) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Bind lookup values with column types ([#3567](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3567) )
- feat(tables): Add semantic search storage and shared contracts ([#3503](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3503) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Preserve Slack errors during runtime cleanup ([#3556](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3556) )
- refactor(agents): Share output schema normalization ([#3562](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3562) )
- feat(skills): Add agent skill update and draft UDFs ([#3561](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3561) )
- docs(agents): Document private CIDR allowlist for on-prem LLM providers ([#3568](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3568) )


## Tracecat MCP


- feat(mcp): Add workspace sync export and pull tools ([#3566](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3566) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Add region_name and cap threads in DuckDB action ([#3559](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3559) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Fall back when dependency compilation fails ([#3563](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3563) )


## API


- feat(api): SMTP delivery ([#3401](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3401) )
- feat(api): Add invitation email outbox delivery ([#3424](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3424) )
- feat(api+ui): Resend invitation emails ([#3427](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3427) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Stop toasting 403 responses ([#3557](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3557) )


## Infrastructure


- infra: Add pgvector support to application databases ([#3500](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3500) )
- ci: Publish releases from branches and guard latest ([#3560](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3560) )


## Other changes


- chore: Allow model invocation of gh-prerelease skill ([#3496](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3496) )


## Upgrade and validation notes


- The application database requires pgvector 0.8.0 or newer in the public schema, even when semantic search is disabled. See[pgvector setup](https://docs.tracecat.com/self-hosting/pgvector) .
- Known upgrade issue: automatic platform registry synchronization rejects an existing registry version of` 1.1.0-alpha.1.1` . The API may start while registry synchronization remains incomplete. This alpha does not include a fix.
- Unit, registry, and Temporal checks passed on the base commit. Scheduled integration tests did not run because CI SSH authentication failed; publication proceeds with that validation exception accepted.
- The workspace sync MCP tools from[#3566](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3566) were reverted before this release. The workflow dependency fallback fix was already present in` 1.1.0-alpha.1.1` .


**Full changelog** :[1.1.0-alpha.1.1...1.1.0-alpha.2](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.1.0-alpha.1.1...1.1.0-alpha.2)
